channel.title: Tool Use Cases: Daily builder log
channel.description: Daily log test, Nov 2–13, 2026. Weekdays only. Only verified breaking changes, deadlines and price changes. Published by Lali Publications.

item.title: Daily builder log: Oct 31, 2026 (format preview)
item.description: Deadline: Jules: Google is winding Jules down: you can keep working in sessions until Nov 11, 2026, then Jules is read-only until it shuts down on Dec 31, 2026. Test for this: Before Nov 11, export any sessions you need with the Jules Tools CLI (npm install -g @google/jules) and move open tasks to another coding agent. Source: https://jules.google/docs/changelog/ (checked 08:06 PM PT) | Breaking change: Bolt.new: Since Oct 30, 2026, new Bolt database tables are private by default and your app needs explicit permissions to read or write them; existing databases are not affected. Test for this: Create a new table in a test project and read and write it from the app; if you get a database permissions error, ask Bolt to fix the table permissions. Source: https://support.bolt.new/release-notes (checked 08:06 PM PT) | Price change: Bolt.new: From Nov 1, 2026, Link (by Stripe) bills Bolt plan and domain subscriptions: plans and token allowances stay the same, but Link adds sales tax or VAT where your region requires it. Test for this: Check your next Bolt invoice for tax; if checkout offers your local currency, note the charge can vary month to month with the exchange rate, and USD stays available for a fixed price. Source: https://support.bolt.new/release-notes (checked 08:09 PM PT) | Deadline: Lovable: Lovable's docs say the current chat pricing (per-message price and daily chat allowance) is a temporary offering that applies through Oct 31, 2026; the page does not say what applies after. Test for this: Recheck the Lovable chat docs and your plan's chat allowance on Nov 2 before budgeting chat-heavy work. Source: https://docs.lovable.dev/features/chats (checked 08:07 PM PT) | Deadline: Claude Code: Fast mode for Opus 4.8 is deprecated as of Oct 30, 2026 and will be removed on Nov 30, 2026; after that, fast mode requests on Opus 4.8 return an error instead of falling back. Test for this: Find scripts and settings that use fast mode with Opus 4.8 and switch them to Opus 5.5 to keep the speedup before Nov 30. Source: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md (checked 08:07 PM PT)
